exposure: fetuses with an estimated fetal weight (EFW) <3rd percentile
fetuses with an abdominal circumference (AC) <3rd percentile and EFW 3rd to 9th percentile
outcome: composite neonatal outcome (neonatal intensive care unit admission >48 hours, necrotizing enterocolitis, sepsis, respiratory distress syndrome, mechanical ventilation, retinopathy of prematurity, seizures, intraventricular hemorrhage, stillbirth, or death before discharge)
small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
cohort: The study included 743 singleton fetuses with an EFW <3rd percentile or AC <3rd percentile with EFW 3rd to 9th percentile, observed at 28 weeks' gestation or greater at a tertiary academic center.
finding: Fetuses with EFW <3rd percentile had significantly higher rates of composite neonatal outcomes (57.5%) and SGA at birth (94.9%) compared to fetuses with AC <3rd percentile and EFW 3rd to 9th percentile (20.9% composite outcome, 75.6% SGA), though the latter group still exhibited moderate rates of adverse perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA) defined as birth weight <10th percentile for gestational age was an outcome measure.
